entities.name: Caliman
entities.description: A large island far south of Dominaria, southeast of Jamuraa, where magic and technology are both used.

entities.name: Alaborn
entities.description: A highly advanced human kingdom on Caliman's southern plains.

entities.name: The Talas
entities.description: A region of islands in the southwest of Caliman.

entities.name: Norwood
entities.description: The elven forest covering much of northern Caliman.

entities.name: Dakmor
entities.description: A swampy island north of the mainland, home of Tojira.

entities.name: Tojira
entities.description: The swamp queen of Dakmor, with nightstalker minions.

relations.quote: Home of the swamp queen Tojira and her nightstalker minions
